purpose: Declare the safe operating-system surfaces available to the Marketing Chief Buzz team without turning Buzz into a second queue, credential store, or source of truth.

bindings.name: Canonical Client Operations
bindings.use: Client registry, versioned queue, approvals, execution graphs, policies, evidence, and durable handoffs.

bindings.name: Marketing Chief Operator Studio
bindings.use: Owner commands, direct agent and room messages, approvals, safe delivery evidence, and portfolio status.

bindings.name: Watchtower and Scheduled Tasks
bindings.route: Windows Task Scheduler plus canonical state
bindings.use: Liveness, stalled handoffs, bounded recovery, evidence freshness, and scheduled synchronization.

bindings.name: Buzz Desktop and ACP
bindings.route: Official Block Buzz desktop plus hosted private community
bindings.use: Direct messages, private rooms, agent presence, threads, and subscription-backed ACP sessions.

bindings.name: Codex and Claude ACP Harnesses
bindings.use: Primary execution, research, creative, and independent verification lanes.

bindings.name: OmniRoute and Ollama
bindings.use: Governed model routing, local open-weight inference, quota visibility, resilience, and private model lanes.

bindings.name: Installed Operator Clients
bindings.route: Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Qwen Code, Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Kimi Code
bindings.use: Specialized local operator surfaces; each keeps its own trust, authentication, and workspace boundaries.

bindings.name: MCP Capability Plane
bindings.route: OmniRoute MCP, Marketing Chief Filesystem, Private Memory, and MCP Inspector
bindings.use: Routing, integrations, restricted project files, safe private memory, and protocol inspection.

bindings.name: Access Broker and Bitwarden
bindings.route: Windows Access Broker, Credential Manager, and opaque Bitwarden locators
bindings.use: Exact account selection and authenticated-session continuity. Secret values never enter Buzz, prompts, files, logs, or chat.

bindings.name: Persistent Authenticated Chrome
bindings.use: Read-first provider work and routine authenticated navigation after exact client and account verification.

bindings.name: Gmail Intake
bindings.route: Connected Gmail plus prepare-only canonical intake
bindings.use: Current client requests and historical evidence; raw messages stay outside Buzz and only redacted observations enter intake.

bindings.name: Slack and Cursor Intake
bindings.route: Connected Slack plus bounded Cursor collaboration
bindings.use: Exact-channel evidence, redacted intake, and proposed replies. No autonomous posting or queue mutation.

bindings.name: HubSpot and Lifecycle
bindings.use: CRM, CMS, lifecycle, attribution, forms, and reporting with strict client and portal separation.

bindings.name: Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Analytics
bindings.route: Exact account mappings through connected apps or authenticated Chrome
bindings.use: Brand-separated delivery, tracking, KPI validation, and staged campaign work. Spend and live mutation retain approval gates.

bindings.name: GitHub, Sites, and Netlify
bindings.route: Authenticated source control and exact mapped deployment targets
bindings.use: Versioned implementation, private dashboard releases, staging, rollback evidence, and approved mapped-site publication.
